text:
zoe: Dropping a fresh compact one-pager draft for a compliance-first launch: includes audit-forward SLA bullets, a 1-line deploy decision row, procurement checklist for SOC2/PCI buyers, and a micro-bench. Link: https://drive.redwood/compliance-onepager/v1

harry: Nice. Field asks for an AE-ready top line and a CISO email snippet. Can we add both in the doc? CISO snippet should be 1 sentence and call out KMS + audit logs.

mica: Added both snippets. CISO: "Private connect + verifiable audit logs for LLM inference 1 SLA-backed latency tiers." AE quickline: "Predictable P99 latency and explicit failover controls across Hosted/Dedicated/Private."

zoe: Great. Bench numbers in the one-pager are intentionally conservative: median ~55ms, p99 ~210ms (seq<=512) on Hosted baseline; est cost ~$0.07/k tokens. Note: batching + quantization can materially lower cost.

devrel: For storytelling, recommend the blog launch post lead: "How to buy predictable inference for regulated products" and a webinar titled "Audit-forward inference: SLAs, routing, and procurement readiness". We should CTA to the one-pager and a procurement checklist PDF.

harry: Inbound routing rules proposed in doc. Short rule block for router team:
```
# simplified inbound routing logic
if lead.industry in ["finserv", "healthcare"] and lead.deploy_interest == "private":
  route_to = "solutions-enterprise@redwood"
  tags = ["ciso", "private-deploy"]
elif lead.deploy_interest == "dedicated":
  route_to = "dedicated-sales@"
  tags = ["platform"]
else:
  route_to = "growth@"
  tags = ["hosted"]
# also annotate urgency: lead.stage in ["pilot", "poc", "rfp"]
```

mica: I added `priority` and `procurement_stage` fields so AE queues can filter: pilot|poc|rfp. Also added recommended AE SLA: initial response within 24h for pilot, 48h for poc, 72h for rfp.

design-bot: task created: compliance_onepager_v1 -> visual comps. Deliverables: 1x one-pager PNG, 1x slide-ready PNG, 2x social banners. ETA: EOD.

zoe: Procurement checklist draft (6 bullets) lives in the doc. Short version includes: KMS integration, audit log retention, attestations, export controls, network peering, support SLAs. Field wants a 1-paragraph procurement-ready summary for buyers.

devrel: I'll write the 1-paragraph buyer summary. Also proposing two webinar segments: 18m bench + 15m procurement checklist + 15m live demo (routing + dashboard) + 12m Q&A. Keep runtime eng and solutions SE on call.

harry: Demo script draft is in the doc. Tiny ask: make it a 5-step script so design can storyboard. Example: 1) start baseline request, 2) drive spike, 3) show autoscale lag, 4) show routing fallback to Dedicated, 5) confirm audit trail for Private.

mica: I trimmed it to 5 lines and added exact UI clicks for the dashboard. Also included a 2-sentence narration for the moderator.

router-bot: routing-check: test suite run 24 leads -> expected routes: 6 solutions-enterprise, 10 growth, 8 dedicated-sales. No rule conflicts.

ops-bot: publish-bot: asset build succeeded: compliance_onepager_v1.pdf (hash: c0ffee42).

zoe: Final ask: please leave comments on the Drive doc by 3pm PT. If no blockers, we'll publish the one-pager, create the launch post draft, and schedule the webinar for the next available marketer slot. Thanks! :lock: :chart_with_upwards_trend:
